transcript.ndjson: Recorded provider wire. First record is transcript_start; the rest are expect_outbound and emit_inbound entries. A replay answers each outbound request from the next recorded inbound frame.
input.json: The user steps that drive the replay, with the model selection and runtime modes.
events.json: The domain events a replay must produce, in order, as JSON.

normalization.workspace: The replay's temp workspace path is written as <workspace> and its basename as <workspace-name>.
normalization.timestamps: Every ISO timestamp is written as <time>. Wall-clock values differ per run and a race shifts the test clock by a millisecond, so no value is pinned.
normalization.uuids: UUIDs minted by the adapter are written as <uuid:N>, numbered by first appearance in events.json. UUIDs that occur in the transcript stay as recorded.
